caseStudies.title: Case Study: Corporate Espionage & Memory Dump Forensic Investigation
caseStudies.problem: Unusual data exfiltration detected over encrypted HTTPS connection to unlisted IP address.
solution: Acquired raw RAM image from suspicious workstation before rebooting
Ran Volatility process tree plugin to reveal rogue DLL injected into lsass.exe process
Reconstructed file access timeline from $MFT and Windows Registry artifacts
outcomes: Identified insider threat attempting to exfiltrate proprietary CAD blueprints
Produced court-ready SHA-256 verified forensic report resulting in employee termination & legal prosecution
